examples.description: Pull a clip's end edge back to 2 seconds on the timeline

description: Trim a timeline clip's start or end edge to an absolute TIMELINE millisecond. The clip keeps its id and its source in/out points move with the edge, so the footage stays in sync. Refuses if the trim would leave under 100ms, cross a neighbouring clip, or run past the source media.

at_ms.description: Absolute TIMELINE position for the new edge, not an offset.
